title: FarmersMC Chunkloader
description: A Chunkloading Mod. To keep your farms running
body:
# FarmersMC Chunkloader

Keep your chunks loaded while going else where. Handy for farms and places that needs to keep be constantly rendered. You can use it with ease including a map to select your loaded chunks.

**Features:**
- Based on FTB Chunks
- Easy to use
- And many more to discover!


Based on FTB Chunks as reference ([Check Here FTB Chunks](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ftb-chunks-forge))
Has some non-fixable bugs like a blurry chunk selection screen

**You can use it freely in your Modpack, Do not redistribute!**
